rows.grounds: compound of pārṣṇi (heel), ghāta (strike), ādi (etc.), with instrumental plural ending bhiḥ
accusative plural of bhauma plus ādi (and others)
gerund/absolutive of apasṛ, indicating removal before the main action

items.question: Which earthly and other obstacles are removed by heel-strike before entry?
items.inference: The practitioner removes earthly and other obstacles by heel-strike before proceeding.
uncertainties: The exact list of obstacles beyond earthly ones is not specified.
items.plain_english: Having removed earthly and other obstacles by heel-strike and the like, one proceeds.
